messages:
becka: Quick sync  proposing a compact list for prompt-set evals. Main asks: keyboard-first nav, clear diff summaries, and a bulk-approve modal that doesn't OOM on 200 items. Thoughts?

omar: Compact list + chevron-expand for details. Keep headers as buttons with aria-expanded. Up/Down to move, Enter/Space toggles.

lucy: Diff summary line at top of expanded area: e.g. "2 additions  1 removal" so you don't have to tab each token. Also prefer overlay highlights to avoid reflow.

nate: Overlay CSS idea (no animation):
```
.diff-token { position: relative; }
.diff-token::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(255,235,59,0.14); pointer-events: none; }
```
Make tokens tabindex=0 and set data-change for SR text.

aria: Bulk approve flow: select -> confirm sheet. Don't load full provenance for all items. Show condensed list + lazy-load per item. Modal must trap focus, Esc to dismiss, and announce progress via aria-live ("Loaded 10 of 120 provenance entries").

becka: Copy: single = "Approve"; bulk = "Approve selected". Add tooltip on approve: "Records reviewer & timestamp (auditable)". Also use icons + text for status (not color-only).

omar: Accessibility: respect prefers-reduced-motion. If we animate height on expand, disable for reduced-motion. Also ensure focus outlines are high-contrast.

lucy: I'll update Figma with compact rows, overlay diffs, and modal mock for lazy provenance. Tagging eng + design for review. React :thumbsup: to proceed or :eyes: to request copy review.

nate: :thumbsup:

aria: :eyes: want to review modal copy before we merge.
